# Jason Walls · software built by an electrician who ships

> Websites, iOS apps, internal tools and AI workflows for trades, local businesses and founders.
> Fixed price, weekly previews, weeks not quarters. Louisville, Kentucky; works remotely across the US.

## Who
Jason Walls is an electrician (IBEW Local 369) who builds software with Claude Code and parallel agents.
Shipped: ChargeRight (web at https://evchargeright.com and iOS, App Store id 6755695416), BendRight
(iOS, App Store id 6779847124, $6.99), ZombieWells (https://zombiewells.com, with attorney Sarah Stogner).
Public tooling: https://github.com/LeeHigma0201/claude-code-mods

## Packages (prices proposed, 2026-10)
- Launch Site: $3,500, 1 week. Up to 5 pages, booking form, schema, analytics, your domain.
- Your Business on Claude: $4,500, 2 weeks. 1–3 AI workflows installed where the crew works, training, guardrails.
- MVP Web App or Internal Tool: from $12,000, 3 weeks. Login, database, payments, one AI feature, tests, weekly preview.
- iOS App to the App Store: from $10,000, 4 weeks. Capacitor or SwiftUI, StoreKit, submission handled.
- Care Plan: $400/month, 3 hours of changes, cancel anytime. Extra day: $1,200.

## Process
Discovery call (20 min, free) → scoped brief → fixed quote (50% to start) → build with a preview link every week → launch on the client's own accounts (they own code, domain, data) → 30 days of fixes, then Care if wanted.
